decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet builds on the firm's textile and material know-how, and it kept its own page in 2024, which shows continued support within its established rug collection.

The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws directly on the firm's craftsmanship and fine-materials expertise, and it is steadily presented on its own page, so the firm can judge and support its premium positioning.

The corner bench lost its own page in 2024 but is still promoted as a new interpretation of a classic, and it fits the firm's core furniture and designer-collaboration knowledge, so a short further trial is warranted.

The low-pile carpet relies on the same assimilated carpet knowledge as the other rugs and remains featured, although the sibling Product C was already dropped, which points to some pruning risk in this collection.

The swivel shell chair line with several models lies at the heart of the firm's seating and design capabilities and stays fully presented, which signals strong commitment and the ability to keep developing it.
